ai_pattern_analysis_enabled.description: Gates the Tier 1/2 Gemini quote-suggestion path. Tier 3 is always curated (ADR-0012). Flip to false if Gemini misbehaves — Tier 1/2 falls back to the curated pool.

gemini_detection_enabled.description: Gates the analyzeMoodText CF suggestion pill on Log Mood. Flip to false if Gemini is down or returns bad suggestions; manual mood entry still works.

intervention_dispatch_enabled.description: Master enable for the cheer-up push dispatcher. Default false: the Pattern Engine still writes patterns/{date}, but no push fires. Flip on once the dispatcher reads triggeredTier (ADR-0011 §4).

history_privacy_lock_enabled.description: Kill-switch for the History privacy gate (ADR-0013). Default true. Flip to false to disable globally; stored PIN hashes stay at rest, no data loss.

version.description: MoodBloom feature flag baseline — keep in sync with apps/mobile/lib/app/feature_flags.dart and apps/mobile/lib/main.dart setDefaults().
